name: jsndarray
description: A NumPy-like library for JavaScript, powered by WebAssembly.

scripts.prebuild: npm run doc && npm run build:types
scripts.build: esbuild src/ndarray.js --bundle --outfile=dist/ndarray.mjs --format=esm --external:fs --external:path --external:util && esbuild src/ndarray.js --bundle --outfile=dist/ndarray.cjs --format=cjs --platform=node && esbuild src/ndarray.js --bundle --outfile=dist/ndarray.browser.js --format=iife --global-name=ndarray --external:fs --external:path --external:util
